policy: Observed usage by response completion timestamp in [start,end). A boundary-straddling response is attributed wholly to its completion window. Cached/write input and reasoning output are subsets; do not add them twice. No observed records means unknown, not free work. Missing or delayed usage may require a later audit. Elapsed windows include tool waits. These observations are not a bill or causal engine savings estimate.
coverage_note: Between-window records remain visible as unattributed overhead. Span elapsed includes gaps and is not active correction time. Records outside the span are excluded. The last report/commit response may need the next audit.
scope: Article selection, source-only page/layout inspection and protocol design. Neither OCR arm nor semantic correction started. Final validation/commit/report tail after cutoff excluded. Shared experiment preparation, not charged exclusively to either engine.
